# Vertex Solutions

Canonical website: https://vertexfirm.vercel.app/

Vertex Solutions is a business services company supporting companies with startup expansion, commercial growth, technology implementation and operations.

## Main pages
- Home: https://vertexfirm.vercel.app/
- About: https://vertexfirm.vercel.app/about
- Services: https://vertexfirm.vercel.app/services
- Contact: https://vertexfirm.vercel.app/contact

## Service areas
- Startup expansion from India to the United States
- Import-export vendor coordination
- Business development and commercial introductions
- Fundraising support
- Sales development and customer acquisition
- SEO, AEO, GEO and digital or offline marketing
- Recruitment and hiring
- Data brokerage, subject to permissions and applicable law
- AI workflow integration and agentic workflow design
- Research-specific model training
- Brand launches
- Manufacturing operations and factory setup coordination

## Scope and claims
Service availability and deliverables depend on each engagement's agreed scope. The website does not claim guaranteed funding, sales outcomes, approvals, certifications or unverified testimonials. Cross-border requirements should be confirmed with the relevant authorities and qualified advisers.
